kernel: the fixed r=5 centered difference-set kernel from H-F2-01
variables: one state in {inactive,0,1,2,3,4} for each of the 1248 fractional coarse edges
objective: exact sum of cyclic intersection factors for triangles, C4s, diamonds and K4s
algorithm: deterministic strict coordinate descent in lexicographic edge order
limits: at most 8 sweeps and 180 seconds; no restart and no seed
postprocessing: one exact integer q minimization on the retained phase/support assignment
recount_admission: materialize and generically recount exactly one candidate only if its exact predicted density is below association-scheme-r5-001
scope: one causal phase/support optimization, not a kernel, seed or hyperparameter sweep
